target.statement: Test accuracy of solving 2x2x2 Rubik's cube (cube ordering) on the brain hemorrhage dataset: 99.7% (rearrange only) and 92.0% (rearrange + rotate)
target.dataset: Brain hemorrhage dataset (1486 brain CT volumes, collected from a collaborative hospital)

compute.basis: The target requires the proprietary brain hemorrhage CT dataset (1486 volumes from a hospital) and the paper provides no code, so the number cannot be reproduced without re-collecting the data and re-implementing the full Siamese-Octad 3D VGG training pipeline.

blockers: Proprietary brain hemorrhage CT dataset collected from a collaborative hospital, not publicly available
No code or model weights released
Requires training a Siamese-Octad 3D VGG network on 3D volumes, which is GPU-intensive
title: Self-supervised Feature Learning for 3D Medical Images by Playing a Rubik's Cube
